# 004: Splitting an amount drops cents

split(Decimal("10.00"), 3) returns three shares of 3.33 and a cent disappears. The shares must add up to the original amount, with the extra cents going to the first shares. The test pins down what split should do. Now src/ledgerlite/money.py.
The rounding mode looks wrong. I'll let quantize use the default rounding.
